evidence.citation: “Before editing the skill: 1. Reconfirm the skill’s first principles and that the intended eval mode is judgment rather than conformance. 2. Ask the user whether the seven headings are genuinely part of the required output contract. 3. If not, rewrite the golden-case bar around the desired outcome and unacceptable smells, then regrade the blind artifacts.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The requested steps directly diagnose whether the evaluation bar matches the intended judgment-oriented task and establish the correct output contract before any skill edit. Regrading after correcting a mismatched bar validates the outcome and regression status, so the artifact requires no materially unnecessary execution work.
